content.text:
Create an SVG logo for a generative AI company using organic shapes and neutral tones

Deliver the result as image and/or video files, working in the current directory.
- Save the finished files in ./output/. Only what is in ./output/ is published as the result, so
  ./output/ holds those finished image/video files and nothing else.
- Formats: images as .png, .jpg, .webp, .gif or .svg; videos as .mp4 or .webm. At most 8 files,
  each under 2 MB; videos at most 10 seconds.
- Tools available on this machine: python3 3.15.0 (standard library only), node 26.12.0 (no npm packages), ffmpeg 9.0.2, ffprobe 9.0.2. Don't install packages or download anything.
- Keep the code you write to make the files in the working directory (its root, or a subdirectory
  like ./src/, but not in ./output/): it's published as the source. Delete intermediate files such
  as rendered frames when you're done.
- Only create or edit files inside the current directory.
- Finish with a short summary of what you made.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p output src && cat > src/logo.svg <<'E'
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 240" width="640" height="240">
<rect width="640" height="240" fill="#EFEAE2"/>
<g transform="translate(120 120)">
<path d="M0-78C42-84 80-52 76-8C72 38 36 72-8 70C-52 68-82 34-76-12C-70-52-38-74 0-78Z" fill="#8A7F72"/>
<path d="M-4-52C26-58 54-34 50-6C46 24 18 46-12 42C-40 38-56 14-50-14C-46-34-28-48-4-52Z" fill="#C9BFB0"/>
<path d="M-2-24C16-28 30-14 26 2C22 18 6 24-8 18C-22 12-24-2-18-14C-14-20-8-23-2-24Z" fill="#3E3832"/>
<circle cx="52" cy="-50" r="10" fill="#3E3832"/>
</g>
<text x="230" y="125" font-family="Georgia, serif" font-size="58" fill="#3E3832" letter-spacing="2">Loam</text>
<text x="233" y="157" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" fill="#8A7F72" letter-spacing="6">GENERATIVE AI</text>
</svg>
E
cp src/logo.svg output/logo.svg

content.text:
I made an SVG logo for a fictional generative AI company called "Loam". It's saved as `output/logo.svg`. I haven't opened or rendered it, so I haven't seen how it looks.

- **Mark:** three nested blob shapes in taupe, sand and charcoal, with a small charcoal dot at the upper right.
- **Wordmark:** "Loam" in a serif typeface, with "GENERATIVE AI" in small spaced sans-serif capitals underneath.
- **Colors:** a warm off-white background with stone, sand and charcoal.

The text uses system fonts (Georgia and Helvetica/Arial). It may look slightly different on machines without them.

The source is in `src/logo.svg`.
